indicators.malware_family: Stealer Log C2 / Fake SSL-VPN Gateway
indicators.description: Cyble Vision: Rogue SSL VPN login portal harvesting corporate two-factor tokens and active session cookies.
Cyble Vision: Targeted financial spoof domain attempting in-transit session interception for commercial bank accounts.
Cyble Vision: Lookalike domain mimicking enterprise webmail to facilitate executive spear-phishing.
Cyble Vision: Illicit consent grant app endpoint used by FIN7 to hijack corporate Entra ID / Microsoft 365 tokens.
Cyble Vision: Fake salary review portal delivering obfuscated ISO and LNK loaders executing in-memory PowerShell.
Cyble Vision: Evilginx2 reverse proxy infrastructure actively bypassing corporate multi-factor authentication (MFA).
Cyble Vision: Dynadot fast-flux hosting node resolving active corporate phishing domains.
Cyble Vision: Russian underground command-and-control server receiving automated browser stealer zip archives.
Cyble Vision: Dedicated affiliate exfiltration server running StealBit multi-threaded file transfer.

indicators.malware_family: Initial Access Broker RDP Tunnel Proxy
indicators.description: Cyble Vision: High-risk reverse RDP proxy node used by Initial Access Brokers to maintain persistent corporate shell access.
Cyble Vision: Active C2 gateway coordinating in-memory DLL reflection and POS memory scraping.
Cyble Vision: Darknet proxy aggregating authenticated browser cookie fingerprints for resale on Genesis Market.
Cyble Vision: Clearnet paste mirror hosting leaked corporate API authorization tokens and department rosters.
Cyble Vision: Automated ransomware exfiltration node detected scanning subnet for shared SMB drives.
Cyble Vision: Dynamic DNS dead-drop resolver utilized by Lazarus Group for staging ransomware key exchange.
Cyble Vision: Packed RedLine Stealer executable extracting Chrome, Edge, and Outlook cached credentials.
Cyble Vision: LockBit Black (v3.0) encryption payload using multi-threaded AES-GCM + Curve25519 routines.
Cyble Vision: Carbanak modular backdoor binary injecting into svchost.exe to manipulate point-of-sale memory.
Cyble Vision: FASTCash ISO 8583 message interception binary targeting banking application servers.
Cyble Vision: StealBit high-speed multithreaded data exfiltration agent compressing and uploading corporate shares.
Cyble Vision: Obfuscated dropper binary executing Hermes ransomware and wiping volume shadow copies via vssadmin.
Cyble Vision: Component DLL reading encrypted master keys from Local State and decrypting DPAPI passwords.

indicators.malware_family: Trend Micro OfficeScan Directory Traversal Vulnerability
indicators.description: Trend Micro OfficeScan contains a directory traversal vulnerability by extracting files from a zip file to a specific folder on the OfficeScan server, leading to remote code execution.

indicators.threat_actor: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan
indicators.malware_family: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan contain an unspecified vulnerability within a migration tool component that allows for remote code execution.

indicators.threat_actor: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan and Worry-Free Business Security Agents
indicators.malware_family: Trend Micro Multiple Products Content Validation Escape Vulnerability
indicators.description: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security agents contain a content validation escape vulnerability that could allow an attacker to manipulate certain agent client components.

indicators.threat_actor: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security
indicators.malware_family: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Access Control Vulnerability
indicators.description: Trend Micro Apex One, OfficeScan, and Worry-Free Business Security on Microsoft Windows contain an improper access control vulnerability that may allow an attacker to manipulate a particular product folder to disable the security temporarily, abuse a specific Windows function, and attain privilege escalation.

indicators.threat_actor: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan
indicators.malware_family: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
indicators.description: Trend Micro Apex One and OfficeScan server contain a vulnerable EXE file that could allow a remote attacker to write data to a path on affected installations and bypass root login.

indicators.threat_actor: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
indicators.malware_family: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
indicators.description: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

indicators.threat_actor: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security
indicators.malware_family: Trend Micro Multiple Products Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
indicators.description: Trend Micro Apex One, Apex One as a Service, and Worry-Free Business Security contain an improper input validation vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to upload files.
TVT devices utilizing NVMS-1000 software contain a directory traversal vulnerability via GET /.. requests.
Unraid contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows attackers to gain access to the administrative interface. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5847 for remote code execution.
Unraid contains a vulnerability due to the insecure use of the extract PHP function that can be abused to execute remote code as root. This CVE is chainable with CVE-2020-5849 for initial access.

indicators.malware_family: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the widgetConfig[code] parameter in an ajax/render/widget_php routestring request.

indicators.malware_family: vBulletin PHP Module Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: The PHP module within vBulletin contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via crafted subWidgets data in an ajax/render/widget_tabbedcontainer_tab_panel request. This CVE ID resolves an incomplete patch for CVE-2019-16759.

indicators.threat_actor: VMware VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS
indicators.malware_family: VMware ESXi and Horizon DaaS OpenSLP Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
indicators.description: VMware ESXi and Horizon Desktop as a Service (DaaS) OpenSLP contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to port 427 to overwrite the heap of the OpenSLP service to perform remote code execution.
VMware ESXi OpenSLP contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allows an attacker residing in the management network with access to port 427 to perform remote code execution.

indicators.malware_family: VMware Multiple Products Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
indicators.description: VMware Fusion, Remote Console (VMRC) for Mac, and Horizon Client for Mac contain a privilege escalation vulnerability due to improper use of setuid binaries that allows attackers to escalate privileges to root.

indicators.malware_family: VMware vCenter Server File Upload Vulnerability
indicators.description: VMware vCenter Server contains a file upload vulnerability in the Analytics service that allows a user with network access to port 443 to execute code.

indicators.malware_family: VMware vCenter Server Information Disclosure Vulnerability
indicators.description: VMware vCenter Server contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service (vmdir) when the Platform Services Controller (PSC) does not correctly implement access controls. Successful exploitation allows an attacker with network access to port 389 to extract sensitive information.

indicators.malware_family: VMware vCenter Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: VMware vCenter Server vSphere Client contains a remote code execution vulnerability in a vCenter Server plugin which allows an attacker with network access to port 443 to execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

indicators.malware_family: VMware vCenter Server Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
indicators.description: VMware vSphere Client contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Virtual SAN Health Check plug-in, which is enabled by default in vCenter Server, which allows for remote code execution.

indicators.malware_family: Multiple VMware Products Command Injection Vulnerability
indicators.description: VMware Workspace One Access, Access Connector, Identity Manager, and Identity Manager Connector contain a command injection vulnerability. An attacker with network access to the administrative configurator on port 8443 and a valid password for the configurator administrator account can execute commands with unrestricted privileges on the underlying operating system.

indicators.malware_family: WordPress File Manager Plugin Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: WordPress File Manager plugin contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute PHP code and upload malicious files on a target site.

indicators.malware_family: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator Plugin File Download Vulnerability
indicators.description: WordPress Snap Creek Duplicator plugin contains a file download vulnerability when an administrator creates a new copy of their site that allows an attacker to download the generated files from their Wordpress dashboard. This vulnerability affects Duplicator and Dulplicator Pro.

indicators.malware_family: WordPress Social Warfare Plugin Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
indicators.description: WordPress Social Warfare plugin contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. This vulnerability affects Social Warfare and Social Warfare Pro.

indicators.malware_family: Yealink Device Management Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
indicators.description: Yealink Device Management contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

indicators.malware_family: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
indicators.description: Zoho ManageEngine ADSelfService Plus contains an authentication bypass vulnerability affecting the REST API URLs which allow for remote code execution.

indicators.malware_family: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central File Upload Vulnerability
indicators.description: Zoho ManageEngine Desktop Central contains a file upload vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

indicators.malware_family: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) File Upload Vulnerability
indicators.description: Zoho ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus (SDP) contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote users to upload files via login page customization.

indicators.malware_family: Zyxel Multiple Products Use of Hard-Coded Credentials Vulnerability
indicators.description: Zyxel firewalls (ATP, USG, VM) and AP Controllers (NXC2500 and NXC5500) contain a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in an undocumented account ("zyfwp") with an unchangeable password.

indicators.malware_family: Tor Exit Relay / BreachForums Access Point
indicators.description: Cyble Vision: Darknet exit node observed during automated corporate database dump advertisement on BreachForums v2.

indicators.malware_family: Netis WF2419 Devices Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Netis WF2419 devices contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an attacker to perform remote code execution as root through the router's web management page.

indicators.malware_family: Oracle Multiple Products Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Multiple Oracle products contain a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access via T3 or HTTP to takeover the affected system. Impacted Oracle products: Oracle Coherence in Fusion Middleware, Oracle Utilities Framework, Oracle Retail Assortment Planning, Oracle Commerce, Oracle Communications Diameter Signaling Router (DSR).
Oracle Fusion Middleware Reports Developer contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to affect confidentiality and integrity of affected systems.

indicators.threat_actor: Oracle Solaris and Zettabyte File System (ZFS)
indicators.malware_family: Oracle Solaris and Zettabyte File System (ZFS) Unspecified Vulnerability
indicators.description: Oracle Solaris and Oracle ZFS Storage Appliance Kit contain an unspecified vulnerability causing high impacts to confidentiality, integrity, and availability of affected systems.

indicators.malware_family: Oracle WebLogic Server Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
indicators.description: Oracle WebLogic Server contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability within Apache Commons, which can allow for for remote code execution.

indicators.malware_family: Oracle WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution. This vulnerability is related to CVE-2020-14882.

indicators.malware_family: Oracle WebLogic Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability, which is assessed to allow for remote code execution, based on this vulnerability being related to CVE-2020-14750.
Oracle WebLogic Server contains an unspecified vulnerability in the Console component with high impacts to confidentilaity, integrity, and availability.
PlaySMS contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

indicators.threat_actor: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX
indicators.malware_family: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
indicators.description: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability through RadAsyncUpload which leads to code execution on the server in the context of the w3wp.exe process.

indicators.malware_family: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Use-After-Free Vulnerability
indicators.description: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a use-after-free vulnerability that allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to execute code via license services.

indicators.malware_family: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an unspecified vulnerability in the admin web interface that could allow an authenticated attacker to upload a custom template to perform code execution.

indicators.malware_family: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Unrestricted File Upload Vulnerability
indicators.description: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows an authenticated administrator to perform a file write via a maliciously crafted archive upload in the administrator web interface.

indicators.malware_family: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Collaboration Suite Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
indicators.description: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Collaboration Suite contains a buffer overflow vulnerabilities that allows a remote authenticated users to execute code as the root user via maliciously crafted meeting room.

indicators.malware_family: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Pulse Connect Secure contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows an authenticated attacker to perform code execution using uncontrolled gzip extraction.

indicators.malware_family: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
indicators.description: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains a command injection vulnerability that allows remote authenticated users to perform remote code execution via Windows File Resource Profiles.

indicators.malware_family: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure Arbitrary File Read Vulnerability
indicators.description: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure contains an arbitrary file read vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access via HTTPS to send a specially crafted URI.

indicators.threat_actor: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Pulse Policy Secure
indicators.malware_family: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure Command Injection Vulnerability
indicators.description: Ivanti Pulse Connect Secure and Policy Secure allows an authenticated attacker from the admin web interface to inject and execute commands.

indicators.malware_family: Qualcomm Multiple Chipsets Detection of Error Condition Without Action Vulnerability
indicators.description: Multiple Qualcomm chipsets contain a detection of error condition without action vulnerability when improper handling of address deregistration on failure can lead to new GPU address allocation failure.
Multiple Qualcomm Chipsets contain a use after free vulnerability due to improper handling of memory mapping of multiple processes simultaneously.

rConfig lib/ajaxHandlers/ajaxAddTemplate.php contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute OS commands via shell metacharacters in the fileName POST parameter.

indicators.malware_family: Realtek AP-Router SDK Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
indicators.description: Realtek AP-Router SDK HTTP web server boa contains a buffer overflow vulnerability due to unsafe copies of some overly long parameters submitted in the form that lead to denial-of-service (DoS).
Roundcube Webmail contains a file disclosure vulnerability caused by insufficient input validation in conjunction with file-based attachment plugins, which are used by default.

SaltStack Salt contains a path traversal vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs which allows directory access to authenticated users. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

SaltStack Salt contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the salt-master process ClearFuncs due to improperly validating method calls. The vulnerability allows a remote user to access some methods without authentication, which can be used to retrieve user tokens from the salt master and/or run commands on salt minions. Salt users who follow fundamental internet security guidelines and best practices are not affected by this vulnerability.

SaltStack Salt allows an unauthenticated user with network access to the Salt API to use shell injections to run code on the Salt API using the SSH client. This vulnerability affects any users running the Salt API.

indicators.malware_family: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
indicators.description: SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.

indicators.malware_family: SAP NetWeaver Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms Invoker Servlet does not require authentication, allowing for remote code execution via a HTTP or HTTPS request.

indicators.malware_family: SAP NetWeaver XML External Entity (XXE) Vulnerability
indicators.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains an unspecified vulnerability in BC-BMT-BPM-DSK which allows remote, authenticated users to conduct XML External Entity (XXE) attacks.

indicators.malware_family: SAP NetWeaver Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
indicators.description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability allowing unauthenticated access to execute configuration tasks and create administrative users.

indicators.malware_family: SAP Solution Manager Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
indicators.description: SAP Solution Manager User Experience Monitoring contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability which results in complete compromise of all SMDAgents connected to the Solution Manager.

SAP NetWeaver Application Server Java Platforms contains a directory traversal vulnerability via a ..\ (dot dot backslash) in the fileName parameter to CrashFileDownloadServlet. This allows remote attackers to read files.

indicators.malware_family: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser Command Injection Vulnerability
indicators.description: SIMalliance Toolbox Browser contains an command injection vulnerability that could allow remote attackers to retrieve location and IMEI information or execute a range of other attacks by modifying the attack message.
SolarWinds Orion API contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute API commands.

indicators.malware_family: SolarWinds Serv-U Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: SolarWinds Serv-U contains an unspecified memory escape vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution.

indicators.malware_family: SolarWinds Virtualization Manager Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
indicators.description: SolarWinds Virtualization Manager allows for privilege escalation through leveraging a misconfiguration of sudo.

indicators.malware_family: Sonatype Nexus Repository Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Sonatype Nexus Repository contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

indicators.malware_family: SonicWall Email Security Improper Privilege Management Vulnerability
indicators.description: SonicWall Email Security contains an improper privilege management vulnerability that allows an attacker to create an administrative account by sending a crafted HTTP request to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20022 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.
SonicWall SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated user to gain read-only access to unauthorized resources.

indicators.malware_family: SonicWall Email Security Unrestricted Upload of File Vulnerability
indicators.description: SonicWall Email Security contains an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to upload a file to the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20023 to achieve privilege escalation.

indicators.malware_family: SonicWall Email Security Path Traversal Vulnerability
indicators.description: SonicWall Email Security contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows a post-authenticated attacker to read files on the remote host. This vulnerability has known usage in a SonicWall Email Security exploit chain along with CVE-2021-20021 and CVE-2021-20022 to achieve privilege escalation.

indicators.malware_family: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 SQL Injection Vulnerability
indicators.description: SonicWall SSLVPN SMA100 contains a SQL injection vulnerability that allows remote exploitation for credential access by an unauthenticated attacker.

Sophos Firewall operating system (SFOS) firmware contains a SQL injection vulnerability when configured with either the administration (HTTPS) service or the User Portal is exposed on the WAN zone. Successful exploitation may cause remote code execution to exfiltrate usernames and hashed passwords for the local device admin(s), portal admins, and user accounts used for remote access (but not external Active Directory or LDAP passwords).

indicators.malware_family: Sumavision EMR Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) Vulnerability
indicators.description: Sumavision Enhanced Multimedia Router (EMR) contains a cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability allowing the creation of users with elevated privileges as administrator on a device.

indicators.malware_family: Symantec Messaging Gateway Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Symantec Messaging Gateway contains an unspecified vulnerability which can allow for remote code execution. With the ability to perform remote code execution, an attacker may also desire to perform privilege escalating actions.

indicators.malware_family: TeamViewer Desktop Bypass Remote Login Vulnerability
indicators.description: TeamViewer Desktop allows for bypass of remote-login access control because the same AES key is used for different customers' installations. If an attacker were to know this key, they could decrypt protected information stored in registry or configuration files or decryption of the Unattended Access password to the system (which allows for remote login to the system).

indicators.malware_family: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity Cryptographic Weakness Vulnerability
indicators.description: Progress Telerik UI for ASP.NET AJAX and Sitefinity have a cryptographic weakness in Telerik.Web.UI.dll that can be exploited to disclose encryption keys (Telerik.Web.UI.DialogParametersEncryptionKey and/or the MachineKey), perform cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, compromise the ASP.NET ViewState, and/or upload and download files.

indicators.malware_family: Tenda AC11 Router Stack Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
indicators.description: Tenda AC11 devices contain a stack buffer overflow vulnerability in /goform/setmac which allows attackers to execute code via a crafted post request.

indicators.malware_family: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
indicators.description: Tenda AC1900 Router AC15 Model contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute system commands via the deviceName POST parameter.

indicators.threat_actor: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers
indicators.malware_family: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 Routers Command Injection Vulnerability
indicators.description: Tenda AC7, AC9, and AC10 devices contain a command injection vulnerability due to  the "formsetUsbUnload" function executes a dosystemCmd function with untrusted input. Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted goform/setUsbUnload request.
